The Addl. Chief Secy. (Homes)
Counsel for Applicant :- Pranjal Krishna,Tanmay Krishna Srivastava

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Shree Prakash Singh,J.
Counter affidavit filed today by learned Aga is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

The present application under Section 438 Cr.PC. has been filed seeking anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.0009 of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468 & 471 of the I.P.C. 1860, Police Station Reusa, District Sitapur. .

From perusal of the order sheet, it appears that on 07.01.2025 following order was passed wherein the present applicant has been granted interim anticipatory bail:-

sentences.text: "Supplementary affidavit filed today is taken on record.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned AGA for the State and perused the record.

The instant anticipatory bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with the prayer to release him on anticipatory bail in Case Crime No.0009 of 2024, under Sections 420, 467, 468 & 471 of the I.P.C. 1860, Police Station Reusa, District Sitapur.

Contention of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant is a woman and she is innocent and false allegation has been levelled against her though she was not involved in committing the offence.
He submits that the amount so taken has already been paid back to Virendra Kumar, the complainant which is evident from Annexure No.3.

He also added that even assuming the allegation in the F.I.R. to be correct, i.e.,
only a money transaction and there is no criminal intent of the applicant to commit the offence.
He also submits that the applicant was working in HDFC bank at the time of lodging the F.I.R. and at present, she is working in Indusind bank.
He submits that the applicant is undertaking that she will neither flee away from trial proceedings nor tamper with the evidences.

He further submits that the applicant has no previous criminal history and she is a law abiding citizen and she has acute apprehension of being arrested by the police, as such, she may be granted anticipatory bail which she will not misuse.

On the other hand, learned AGA appearing for the State has opposed the contentions aforesaid and submitted that the applicant is named in the F.I.R. and there is sufficient proof that she has committed the offence, as such, she is not entitled to any relief.
Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and after perusal of the record, this Court find it to be a fit case of interim anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: List/put up this matter in second week of February 2025.
In the meantime, learned counsel for the State shall file the counter affidavit.

"
State counsel has failed to demonstrate from the counter affidavit that there is any adversarial fact which are pleaded in the bail application.
This Court finds that the applicant was enlarged on anticipatory bail after thorough considering the merits of the case.

The learned counsel for the State has also failed to submit any fact that the applicant is not cooperating with the investigation proceedings or otherwise any glaring fact which can adversely affect the merit of the case.
